summary: Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass (added coverage for category + half_duration_min, status=finished filter with desc ordering, double_yellow reason persistence, and finish-does-not-delete-events). Frontend: index shows 5 categories in round watch UI; tapping Cadete creates a match with category='Cadete' & half_duration_min=40 and navigates to /match; timer & category label render correctly. Double-yellow logic: 2nd yellow on same dorsal+team triggers 'EXPULSIÓN Doble amarilla · #7' overlay AND persists a red event with reason='double_yellow' (verified via GET events). Direct red card also fires 'EXPULSIÓN' overlay. 5th red card on same team fires 'PARTIDO SUSPENDIDO' overlay ('LOCAL: mínimo de jugadores (5 expulsiones)'), notice-dismiss closes it. Historial lists finished matches and history-row-<id> navigates to acta; acta shows correct score '1 - 0', event rows with minute labels (e.g. "1'") and 'GOL · #5', acta-export button visible, acta-home returns to index. CRITICAL BUG: pressing end-match-button on /summary does NOT navigate to /acta/<id>; it goes back to / (index). All other requirements (backend finish + history + acta reachable via history) work, so the acta is still accessible via HISTORIAL, but the direct post-finish navigation flow is broken.

integration_issues.issue: Pressing end-match-button lands on / instead of /acta/<id>. RCA: match.tsx has useEffect that does router.replace('/') whenever matchId becomes null. finishAndArchive() awaits api.finishMatch then setMatchId(null) — the still-mounted /match screen's effect fires and replaces the route to '/' BEFORE summary's handleEnd can await finishAndArchive's return and call router.replace(`/acta/${id}`). Match is correctly finalized on the backend and appears in HISTORIAL, but the immediate acta navigation is overridden.

action_items: Fix FIN DE PARTIDO navigation. Recommended: in /app/frontend/app/summary.tsx handleEnd, navigate FIRST then finalize state — e.g. `const id = matchId; router.replace(id ? "/acta/" + id : "/"); await finishAndArchive();` (capture matchId from context before it is reset). Alternative: guard match.tsx effect (only redirect when the current pathname is /match) or move the matchId reset out of finishAndArchive and do it explicitly from the caller after navigation. Verify: after end-match-button URL is /acta/<matchId> and acta-score renders finalized score.
critical_code_review_comments: Race between match.tsx redirect effect and summary.handleEnd router.replace causes the FIN DE PARTIDO -> acta navigation to break (see integration_issues). This is the only functional bug found.

MatchContext.finishAndArchive swallows api.finishMatch errors silently (catch {}). Fine for offline UX but note if reliability matters.

rca_of_issue: match.tsx has: useEffect(() => { if (!matchId) router.replace('/'); }, [matchId, router]). In summary.handleEnd: `const id = await finishAndArchive(); if (id) router.replace('/acta/'+id);`. finishAndArchive awaits api.finishMatch then setMatchId(null). Since /match is still mounted (stack), its effect fires as soon as React commits the null matchId — replacing the route to '/'. Then summary resumes and calls router.replace('/acta/'+id) but by then a subsequent render/paint of match's effect (or the promise resolution timing on web) results in '/' being the last replace. Reproduction: pick any category -> add any event -> open summary -> press end-match-button -> URL becomes '/' instead of '/acta/<id>'. Mitigation: navigate BEFORE nulling matchId — e.g. capture matchId in the caller and router.replace to acta first, or gate the match.tsx redirect on pathname === '/match'.
